items.t: Search underway for 2 college students who went missing during hike in Colorado
items.x: A search is underway in Colorado for two college students who went missing while hiking Ice Mountain, a nearly 14,000-foot peak.

items.t: Federal Reserve likely to skip rate hike despite elevated inflation as midterm elections loom
items.x: The Federal Reserve board is meeting Wednesday to determine if its benchmark interest rate should be raised. Analysts say it's likely to remain the same.

items.t: Real Madrid issues public apology to China over Mbappé's Mao Zedong comments
items.x: Real Madrid has apologized to the Chinese people following Kylian Mbappé’s remarks that were considered to be disrespectful of Mao Zedong, the founding leader of Communist China.

items.t: Another breezy day & looking ahead to your Halloween forecast
items.x: We’ll see a mix of sunshine and clouds with highs in the mid-70s, but the wind will be noticeable throughout the day.

items.t: Malaysia seizes servers with advanced AI chips suspected of violating export controls
items.x: Malaysia's customs department has seized 30 servers with advanced AI chips in a suspected export-control violation.

items.t: China takes Mbappé's apology 'seriously' after backlash over his ‘Chinese dictator’ comments
items.x: China has acknowledged soccer star Kylian Mbappé's apology for comments seen as disrespectful to Mao Zedong, the founding leader of Communist China.

items.t: Male supplements recalled for not declaring erectile dysfunction drugs and unapproved SSRI in products
items.x: A male supplement has been recalled after it was found to contain three undeclared drugs that make up two prescription erectile dysfunction medications.

items.t: South Korea fines Google and Apple over unfair app market practices
items.x: South Korea on Wednesday fined Google and Apple a combined $47.6 million, saying they abused their dominance in app store markets by forcing local developers onto their own payment systems and by unfairly delaying app reviews.

items.t: Flávio Bolsonaro flees Brazil through Argentina and is expected to land in Miami
items.x: Flávio Bolsonaro, the defeated Brazilian presidential candidate, has fled to Argentina and then Ecuador with his family, according to Argentina's migration authority.

items.t: A ceasefire in a devastated Ukrainian city holds for its first 30 hours, officials say
items.x: Officials say that a six-day ceasefire in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky in southern Ukraine has held for its first day and night.

items.t: Israelis await final election results as Netanyahu remains far from defeated
items.x: Israelis are closely awaiting final election results and what they mean for Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's far-right government.

items.t: Serbian police say assailant killed after attacking officer outside the Israeli Embassy in Belgrade
items.x: An assailant with knives attacked a police officer guarding the Israeli Embassy in Belgrade and was killed just after midnight on Wednesday.

items.t: UK Treasury chief faces headwinds as he delivers first budget under new prime minister, Andy Burnham
items.x: British Treasury chief John Healey faces a fine balancing act when he delivers his first budget statement, with the economic backdrop made more difficult as a result of the turmoil caused by the Iran war.

items.t: Rays stun Brewers with 2-run rally in 12th inning and force World Series Game 5 with 4-3 win
items.x: Jonny DeLuca and pinch-hitter Ben Williamson singled home runs in a stunning 12th-inning rally, and the Tampa Bay Rays staved off World Series elimination with a 4-3 win over the Milwaukee Brewers that forced Game 5.

items.t: The Latest: As votes are counted, no clear winner emerges in Israel's election
items.x: Votes were being counted as dawn broke in Israel on Wednesday morning, but exit polls suggested that its momentous national election left no clear winner.

items.t: 'The internet used to be fun': Firefox reunites 2000s meme stars for anti-AI ad
items.x: Firefox gathered stars of some of the biggest memes of the 2000s for an ad aimed at swaying internet users away from bigger tech companies.

items.t: Cyclone Arnab hits India's Andhra Pradesh state as tens of thousands are evacuated
items.x: Cyclone Arnab has dumped heavy rain across India’s eastern Andhra Pradesh state, causing extensive damage in some areas after tens of thousands of people were evacuated.

items.t: Global shares are mixed after US stock rally, and oil prices gain more than 1%
items.x: Global stocks are mixed as European markets edge lower after AI-related stocks boosted benchmarks in Tokyo and Seoul.

items.t: A US cruise ship suspends a global voyage in Asia due to fuel costs, stranding 200 passengers
items.x: A U.S. cruise ship on a world voyage has suspended its operations in Cambodia due to fuel costs, forcing hundreds of passengers to abandon their homes.

items.t: Jacksonville City Council approves loan for affordable housing project but debates funding source
items.x: Jacksonville City Council voted on a $2.8 million loan for the Tori Meadows affordable housing project, igniting debate over priorities for the city's housing fund.
